## Background

Information Systems student with a strong builder mindset and hands-on experience designing, building, and iterating on data-driven systems. Skilled in Python, SQL, Tableau, and Excel automation, with a passion for exploring new tools and turning ideas into working solutions. Proven ability to deliver efficient, secure systems supporting HR, finance, and research operations. Known for analytical thinking, rapid learning, compliance-aware design, and leadership across academic, professional, and ethical contexts.
